title: Review on progress of rare earth molecule-based functional materials in 2025
claim: π-bound heavy p-block ligands (Sb, Bi, Ge, Sn) in f-element sandwich complexes add spatial and electronic ligand-field control beyond lighter congeners, strengthen spin–orbit coupling, and increase magnetic anisotropy.
explanation: The authors frame these heavy atoms as breaking the prior restriction to lighter π-ligands. Larger ionic radii and soft-donor character are said to give extra crystal-field dimensions around the rare-earth center and a route to high-performance rare-earth magnets.
scope: f-element sandwich complexes using π-coordination of Sb, Bi, Ge, or Sn.
conditions: π-coordination mode rather than classical O/N donors.
caveats: The anisotropy gain is stated as a design trend across refs. 35–37; numerical barriers are not given in the review.
